title: Will WHO declare hantavirus a Public Health Emergency of International Concern before 2027
reasoning: The Andes hantavirus cluster is small (~13 cases) and cruise-linked with no sustained community spread; WHO chose to declare a PHEIC for Ebola Bundibugyo (May 16, 2026) but explicitly did NOT for hantavirus, and the outbreak is being contained via contact tracing/quarantine. title: Who will be Iran's Supreme Leader on January 1, 2027?

title: When will a majority of G7 members recognize Palestinian statehood?
reasoning: France, UK, and Canada formally recognized Palestine in September 2025 (3 of 7), but the remaining G7 members (Germany, Italy, US, Japan) all currently refuse, so the 4th simultaneous recognition is a hard, contingent step likely many years out. Upper percentiles pushed to the open window end given real chance it never reaches 4 before 2035.
